events.verdict: Williams (OKC) and Wembanyama (SAS) engage and disengage with one another, and marginal contact occurs off-ball.
Williams (OKC) and Wembanyama (SAS) come together in pursuit of the loose ball, and incidental leg-to-leg contact occurs during the rebound.
Dort (OKC) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Dort (OKC) gets his hand to the ball to block the shot prior to incidental contact occurring with Wembanyama's (SAS) arm during the driving shot attempt.
Champagnie (SAS) maintains verticality and absorbs the incidental body contact in his chest as he defends Williams' (OKC) shot attempt.
Castle (SAS) and Holmgren (OKC) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Caruso (OKC) reaches in and initiates contact with Vassell's (SAS) arm at the end of his drive and the contact affects his ability to control the ball.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) makes contact with Wembanyama's (SAS) head, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound.
Williams (OKC) and Castle (SAS) come together at the end of the drive when Williams releases away without extending or delivering contact.
Mitchell (OKC) slides his hand off Wembanyama's (SAS) side without pulling him when Wembanyama receives the entry pass.
Mitchell (OKC) extends his arm forward and marginal brush contact occurs with Wembanyama's (SAS) arm during the drive.
Holmgren (OKC) firms up over his left foot and aligns alongside Wembanyama's (SAS) path when marginal body contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Wembanyama (SAS) lowers his arm as he contests and initiates contact with Holmgren's (OKC) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Holmgren (OKC) delivers contact as he comes down and across Wembanyama's (SAS) arms, and the contact affects his ability to control the ball.
Wallace (OKC) commits a take foul on Castle (SAS).
Fox (SAS) commits a take foul on Holmgren (OKC).
Holmgren (OKC) commits a take foul on Wembanyama (SAS).
Fox (SAS) commits a take foul on Williams (OKC).
Caruso (OKC) wraps his arm around Vassell's (SAS) side, affecting Vassell's FOM and ability to control the inbound pass.
Castle (SAS) commits a take foul on Williams (OKC).
Vassell (SAS) and Caruso (OKC) make an attempt to secure the rebound, and Vassell makes legal contact to Caruso's hand while it is in contact with the ball.
